segments.comment: Independent save inside a tended temple: a neutral gnomish Healer level-teleports to Minetown, maps it, teleports beside the altar (intemple() intones and sets the priest's intone_time about 2,500 turns ahead) and saves. save.c savelev()'s savemonchn() calls priest.c forget_temple_entry() for the priest, so after the restore in segment 2 a teleport out of the temple and back gives a fresh intone and entry message.
